name: 16_parallel_word_count_montecristo
description: TENGO_SKIPPED: tengo has no goroutines/threads. Parallel word-frequency count over The Count of Monte Cristo (Project Gutenberg #1184, ~2.7MB). 16 workers per the language's idiomatic CPU-parallel primitive: goroutines+WaitGroup on Go family, multiprocessing.Pool on Python. Banned: str.split, strings.Fields, regexp, sort.*, sorted(key=...), threading/asyncio. Demonstrates pipit's GIL-free multi-core throughput.
